function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {

  if (typeof node != 'object') return
  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {
    var key = mode + '-' + id
    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))
    }
  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)

  })
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {

  function findExtra(pattern) {

    }
    return ''

  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)

  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor
      response = qmGet.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', bp)
      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {
      var hot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1' ? '1' : '0'
      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')

function qmOpenComment(kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId) {
  var html = qmCommentHtml.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId)
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'showBrowser')) return false
  runtimeJava.showBrowser('https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/', html, 'window.java=java;window.cache=cache;window.source=source;window.qmRun=run;window.qmLocalCommentPage=true;', JSON.stringify({state:4,isHideable:true,heightPercentage:cfg.height,widthPercentage:1.0,dismissOnTouchOutside:true,skipCollapsed:true,expandedCornersRadius:16,isGestureInsetBottomIgnored:true,hardwareAccelerated:true,webViewInitialScale:100}))
  return true
}

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmBubbleImage(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var data = qmSvg.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot)
  return data ? '<img src="' + data + '">' : ''
}

function qmGodImage(bid, cid, pid, gid, text) {
  text = String(text || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim()
  if (!gid || !text) return ''
  if (text.length > 18) text = text.slice(0, 18) + '...'
  var svg = '<svg width="1000" height="120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
    '<rect x="2" y="0" width="996" height="100" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" rx="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>' +
    '<rect x="32" y="22" width="140" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FF4444"/>' +
    '<text x="102" y="64" font-size="32" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">神评</text>' +
    '<text x="196" y="64" font-size="38" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">' + qmEsc(text) + '</text></svg>'
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + ['paragraph', bid, cid, pid, '七猫神评', gid].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var data = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:'FULL',type:'qmpl-god',click:call})
  return '<img src="' + data + '">'
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmContentTitle(value, baseUrl) {
  var text = String(value || '')
  var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeChapter) runtimeChapter.putImgUrl(null) } catch (e) {}
  return text
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

(() => {
    let html = java.ajax("https://bbxxxx.com/"); 
    
    // 阅读 App 在执行发现页 JS 时，可以直接通过变量 page 获取当前页码
    // 如果 page 未定义，默认设为 1
    let p = (typeof page !== 'undefined') ? page : 1;

    const getUrl = (baseUrl) => {
        // 第一页保持原样，后续页码拼接 {{page}}.html
        // 注意：这里直接返回字符串结果，避免在字符串内部嵌套引号
        return p == 1 ? baseUrl : baseUrl + p + ".html";
    };

    let list = [
        { "title": "最新", "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com/rank/new/{{page}}.html"), "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25 } },
        { "title": "热门", "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com/rank/hot/{{page}}.html"), "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25 } },
        { "title": "完本", "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com/rank/complete/{{page}}.html"), "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25 } }
    ];
    
    // 分类
    list.push({ "title": "分类", "url": "", "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1 } });
    let reg1 = /<a href="(\/category\/\d+\/)">(.*?)<\/a>/g;
    let match1;
    while ((match1 = reg1.exec(html)) !== null) {
        list.push({
            "title": match1[2],
            "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com" + match1[1]) + "/{{page}}.html" +  ",{\"webView\":true}",
            "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.2 }
        });
    }

    // 标签
    list.push({ "title": "标签", "url": "", "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1 } });
    let reg = /<a href="(\/tag\/\d+\/)">(.*?)<\/a>/g;
    let match;
    while ((match = reg.exec(html)) !== null) {
        list.push({
            "title": match[2],
            "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com" + match[1]) + "/{{page}}.html" + ",{\"webView\":true}",
            "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.2 }
        });
    }
    
    return JSON.stringify(list);
})()

    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);

    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }

function setArgument(key, value) {
    var open_argument = source.getVariable();
    open_argument = getArguments(open_argument, '') || {};
    open_argument[key] = value;
    var result = JSON.stringify(open_argument);
    source.setVariable(result);
    return result;
}

var open_argument = source.getVariable();
var base_url = getArguments(open_argument, 'server') || '';
var ms = getArguments(open_argument, 'tone_id') || '';
var source_type = getArguments(open_argument, 'source_type') || '男频';
var tab = getArguments(open_argument, 'media') || '小说';
var sources = getArguments(open_argument, 'source') || '番茄';


var sdtoken;
try {
    var loginInfoMap = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {};
    sdtoken = String(loginInfoMap['手动填写番茄token(可不填)'] || '');
} catch (e) {
    sdtoken = '';
}

var rawCookie = getFanqieCookie() || sdtoken;
var match = rawCookie.match(/sessionid=[^;]+/);
var fqcookie = match ? match[0] : '';
var fqssionid = '';
if (!fqcookie) {
    java.toast('您还未登陆番茄账号，无法同步数据哦！');
} else {
    fqssionid = getSessionId(fqcookie)
}
var fqsjurl = base_url + "/bookshelf?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqtjurl = base_url + "/fqrecommend?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqlsurl = base_url + "/fqhistory?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;

var groupDatas = [];
var infoData = [];

function deviceType() {
    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

var hasValidCookie = fqcookie.length > 0;

if (hasValidCookie) {
    function groupQuery() {
        try {
            var url = base_url + "/group_name?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
            var res = java.ajax(url);
            var response = JSON.parse(res);

            if (!(response && response.data)) {}

            response.data.forEach(function(group) {
                var keys = Object.keys(group);
                if (keys.length > 0) {
                    var key = keys[0];
                    var value = group[key];
                    if (value && value.length) {
                        var option = {
                            "method": "POST",
                            "body": {
                                "book_ids": value,
                                "page": "{{page}}"
                            }
                        };
                        groupDatas.push({
                            title: key,
                            url: base_url + "/bookshelf," + JSON.stringify(option),
                            style: {
                                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            });

            if (groupDatas.length % 2 !== 0) {
                groupDatas.push({
                    title: "--",
                    url: "",
                    style: {
                        layout_flexGrow: 1,
                        layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
        }
    }

    try {
        java.longToast("正在加载分组数据...");
        var userUrl = base_url + "/fquser?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
        var userRes = java.ajax(userUrl);
        var userData = JSON.parse(userRes);

        var userName = (userData && userData.data && userData.data.name) ? userData.data.name : '未知用户';
        if (!userName.includes('未知用户')) {
            infoData = [{
                title: userName + "个人中心",
                url: fqsjurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            }, {
                title: "个性推荐(番茄)",
                url: fqtjurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }, {
                title: "历史阅读(番茄)",
                url: fqlsurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }];
        }
        groupQuery();
    } catch (e) {
        java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
    }
}

var style_list = [];
try {
    var durl = `${base_url}/discovestyle?source=${sources}&source_type=${source_type}&tab=${tab}`;
    var res = java.ajax(durl);
    var result = JSON.parse(res);
    style_list = result.data || [];
    if (result.msg) {
        java.toast(result.msg);
    }
} catch (e) {
    java.toast("发现样式获取失败");
}

var finalData = infoData.concat(groupDatas, style_list);
JSON.stringify(finalData);

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);

    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);

  return paramStr;
};

ruleContent.nextContentUrl:
<js>
(function(){
    // 使用正则检测分页标签
    const hasNextLink = /<a\s+rel=\"next\"\s+class=\"next\"[^>]*>下—页<\/a>/i.test(result);
    if (!hasNextLink) return '';
    
    try {
        // 动态生成分页URL（适配数字型URL）
        let url = baseUrl;
        const pageMatch = url.match(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/);
        if (!pageMatch) return '';
        
        const [_, baseId, currentPage] = pageMatch;
        const pageNum = currentPage ? parseInt(currentPage) : 1;
        
        // 安全限制（最大3页）
        if (pageNum > 2) return ''; // 第3页后停止
        
        // 生成新URL（如 /123_2.html → /123_3.html）
        return url.replace(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/, `${baseId}_${pageNum + 1}.html`);
    } catch(e) {
        return '';
    }
})()
</js>

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}
String(decrypt(JSON.parse(result).DATA.CTXT)).replace(/{{title}}/,'')
</js>

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}
String(decrypt(JSON.parse(result).DATA.CTXT)).replace(/{{title}}/,'')
</js>

【话本小说 · 使用说明】(本书源基于 Legado MD3 版本制作调试)
■ 这是什么
话本小说网(www.ihuaben.com)书源, 以同人/原创小说为主, 免费在线阅读。
■ 搜索说明
1. 支持书名/作者搜索(话本站内搜索 so.ihuaben.com)
2. 注意: 话本是同人/原创平台, 没有主流网文(如斗破苍穹等搜不到属正常)
3. 若开「精确搜索」, 只返回书名与关键词完全一致的结果
■ 发现页(5个榜单)
点击榜 / 评论榜 / 收藏榜 / 新书榜 / 新手村, 各100条
■ 正文阅读
1. 章节开头的角色对话已排版为「头像+名字：台词」(模拟聊天, 线性排列)
2. 已自动清除: 评论数字徽标、段评、作者语(角色对话保留)
3. 正文插图已保留; 文字嵌入模式下头像按文字行高显示(较小)
■ MD3版本注意事项
1. 若换书后图片样式未生效: 从书架删除该书重新加入
2. 首次打开较长的书, 目录页(全量章节)加载略慢属正常
3. 图片排版受Legado MD3文本阅读器限制: 图片只能「小尺寸内联同行」或「大尺寸独占一行」, 无法像原网站聊天气泡那样左右分栏

var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {

    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);

    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }

exploreUrl:
<js>
let formatUrl = (url, category_index, order, time_type) => {
  return `{{ URL("/bookcity/${url}", {
"category_index": "${category_index}",
"count": "10",
"page": page - 1,
"order": "${order}",
"time_type": "${time_type}"
}) }}`
}

let push = (title, url, basis) => {
  list.push({
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
      layout_flexGrow: 1,
      layout_flexBasisPercent: basis
    }
  });
};
let list = [];
let order_list = {
  "fans_value": "畅销",
  "no_vip_click": "点击",
  "yp": "月票",
  "word_count": "更新",
  //"track_read": "追读",
  "complet": "完结",
  "blade": "催更",
  "yp_new": "新书",
  "recommend": "推荐",
  //"tsukkomi": "吐槽",
  "favor": "收藏"
};
let time_type_list = {
  "total": "总榜",
  "month": "月榜",
  "week": "周榜"
};

let url = URL("/bookcity/get_category_list");
let response = decrypt(java.ajax(url)).data;
let category_list = response.category_list;
let tag_list = response.tag_list;

for (let timeTypeKey in time_type_list) {
  push(`【 ${time_type_list[timeTypeKey]} 】`, "", 1);
  for (let orderKey in order_list) {
    push(order_list[orderKey], formatUrl("get_rank_book_list", 0, orderKey, timeTypeKey), 0.29);
  }
}
push(`【 分类 】`, "", 1);
for (let item of category_list) {
  let category_index = item.category_index;
  let category_name = item.category_name;
  push(category_name, formatUrl("get_filter_search_book_list", category_index, "", ""), 0.29);
}

push(`【 标签 】`, "", 1);
for (let item of tag_list) {
  let tag_module = item.tag_module;
  let tag_name = item.tag_name;
  push(`${tag_name}`, `{{ URL("/bookcity/get_filter_search_book_list", {
"category_index": "0",
"count": "10",
"page": page - 1,
"${tag_module ? 'tag_module' : 'tag'}": "${tag_module ? tag_module : tag_name}",
}) }}`, 0.29);
}

JSON.stringify(list);
</js>

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
let bookid = java.hexDecodeToString(result)

baseUrl = URL("/book/get_info_by_id", {
  book_id: bookid
});
let $ = decrypt(java.ajax(baseUrl)).data.book_info;

let name = $.book_name;
let author = $.author_name;
let kind = [
  $.category_name,
  $.up_status == '0' ? '连载中' : '已完结',
  $.is_paid == '0' ? 'FREE' : 'VIP'
];
let wordCount = $.total_word_count;
let lastChapter = $.last_chapter_info.chapter_title;
let lastChapterTime = $.last_chapter_info.uptime;
let coverUrl = $.cover;
let tocUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(bookid)},{"type":"Text"}`;
let formatNum = (num) => {
  return +num < 10000 ? num : (+num / 10000).toFixed(1) + "万";
};
let tags = $.tag;
let description = $.description;
let intro = ` 更新日期：${lastChapterTime}
点击：${formatNum($.total_click)}　收藏：${$.total_favor}　月票：${$.total_yp}　推荐票：${$.total_recommend}　打赏：${formatNum($.reward_amount)}　催更：${$.total_blade}
标签：${tags}
简介：${description}`;

result = {
  name: name,
  author: author,
  kind: kind,
  wordCount: wordCount,
  lastChapter: lastChapter,
  intro: intro,
  coverUrl: coverUrl,
  tocUrl: tocUrl
};
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>

<js>
let {
  bookid,
  chapterid
} = JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result));
// java.log(`bookid= ${bookid}, chapterid= ${chapterid}`);

let r1 = decrypt(java.ajax(URL("/chapter/get_chapter_info", {
  chapter_id: chapterid
}))).data.chapter_info;
result = r1.txt_content;
if (r1.is_paid == 1 && r1.auth_access == 0) {

}

result

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let bookid = java.hexDecodeToString(result);

let url = URL(`/chapter/get_chapter_list_group_by_division`, {
  last_update_time: "0",
  book_id: bookid
});

let list = [];
let response = decrypt(java.ajax(url)).data;
let division_list = response.division_list;
let chapter_list_group = response.chapter_list_group;
// java.log(JSON.stringify(chapter_list));

chapter_list_group.map(chaplist => {
  list.push({
    title: division_list.find(item => item.division_id == chaplist.division_id).division_name,
    url: "",
    isVolume: true,
    isVip: false,
    isPay: false,
    ChapterInfo: "",
  })
  chaplist.chapter_list.map(chap => {
    let isVip = chap.is_paid === '1';
    let isPay = chap.auth_access == '1';

    list.push({
      title: chap.chapter_title,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(JSON.stringify({
        bookid: bookid,
        chapterid: chap.chapter_id,
        isVip: isVip,
        isPay: isPay
      }))},{"type":"text"}`,
      isVolume: false,
      isVip: chap.is_paid === '1',
      isPay: chap.auth_access == '1',
      ChapterInfo: `#${chap.chapter_index}/ ${chap.is_paid == '1' ? (chap.auth_access == '1' ? "已购买" : "未购买") : "FREE"} ${chap.word_count}字  ${chap.uptime}`,
    })
  });
});

// list.map((item,index)=>java.log(`${index} == ${JSON.stringify(item)}\n`))
list
</js>

searchUrl:
<js>
let separator = "@@";
let regex = new RegExp(`^${separator}`);

regex.test(key) ? tag(key.replace(regex, ""), page) : search(key, page);
</js>

javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

  uuid: "-"
}

for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
  signstr += `${keys[i]}=${params[keys[i]]}`
}
let signature = java.md5Encode("UqgPMZpjgRZQ7s8JAuUIP5DQdo5O5NB" + signstr + "UqgPMZpjgRZQ7s8JAuUIP5DQdo5O5NB")

}

    var element = tabs.get(i);
    var text = element.text();
    var href = element.attr("href").substring(1);  
    volMap[href] = text;
}
var result = [];
var tabsDiv = document.select(".tabs .tab");
for (var i = 0; i < tabsDiv.size(); i++) {
    var tab = tabsDiv.get(i);
    var tabId = tab.id();

    var tempItems = [];

        var item = items.get(j);

        var text = link.text();
        var href = link.attr("href");
        tempItems.push({
            text: text,
            url: href,
            vol: vol
        });
    }
    tempItems.reverse();
    result = result.concat(tempItems);
}

var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}
String(decrypt(JSON.parse(result).DATA.CTXT)).replace(/{{title}}/,'')
</js>

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

<js>

c=[]
R.forEach(r=>{
	i=String(r.attr('href')).replace(/.+\/\d+\/(\d+)\.html/,`$1`)
	//java.log(i)
	c.push({
		name:r.text(),
		url:r.attr('href'),
		index:i
		})
	})
try{
	o=temp.match(/originalOrder[^=]*=[^\[]*\[([^\]]+)\]/)[1]
	o=o.split(",")
	c.sort((a,b)=>o[c.indexOf(a)]-o[c.indexOf(b)])
	}catch (err){
		java.log(err)
		c.sort((a,b)=>a.index-b.index)
		}
	result=c

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

variableComment:
1、书籍变量（当前书）
填写 [去章节序号] —— 去除章节序号
填写 [目录简介] —— 章节简介放到目录列表，正文不出现
填写 [评论+评论数量]——如 评论50  则可以显示50条评论，数量必填

2、源变量（所有书）
其余同书籍变量
填写[搜索+书名] —— 必须在第一行，搜索百合书籍，在发现里点击[百合搜索]

更改过后都要重新刷新

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}
String(decrypt(JSON.parse(result).DATA.CTXT)).replace(/{{title}}/,'')
</js>

        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));

//md5加密开始
var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))
}
var FF = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(F(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var GG = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(G(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var HH = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(H(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var II = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(I(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var convertToWordArray = function(string) {
    var lWordCount;
    var lMessageLength = string.length;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempOne = lMessageLength + 8;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempTwo = (lNumberOfWordsTempOne - (lNumberOfWordsTempOne % 64)) / 64;
    var lNumberOfWords = (lNumberOfWordsTempTwo + 1) * 16;
    var lWordArray = Array(lNumberOfWords - 1);
    var lBytePosition = 0;
    var lByteCount = 0;

<js>
//md5加密开始
var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))
}
var FF = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(F(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var GG = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(G(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var HH = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(H(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var II = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(I(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var convertToWordArray = function(string) {
    var lWordCount;
    var lMessageLength = string.length;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempOne = lMessageLength + 8;

var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

function encryptByDES(massage, keydata) {
        let cipher = Cipher.getInstance("DES");
        let keySpec = new DESKeySpec(String(keydata).getBytes());
         let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
         let key = keyFactory.generateSecret(keySpec);      
        cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key);
        return Base64.encodeToString(cipher.doFinal(String(massage).getBytes()),Base64.NO_WRAP)
}
}

  try {

    )
  } catch (e) {}
  let ywkey = cookie.getKey("qidian.com", "ywkey")

  putLoginHeader({
  	  guid: ywguid,
  	  key: ywkey
  })
  cookie.removeCookie("qidian.com")
  // java.toast("没做完:(")
}

function login() {}

function tokenLogin() {
  if (source.getLoginInfoMap() == null) {
    java.toast("未获取到LoginInfoMap，请尝试重新打开登录UI再按一遍")
  }
  putLoginHeader({
    guid: source.getLoginInfoMap()["ywguid"],
    key: source.getLoginInfoMap()["ywkey"]
  })
  java.toast("凭据保存成功")
}

function proxyExcWrapper(fun) {
  try {
    fun()
  } catch (e) {
    java.log(e.toString() + "\n" + e.stack)
  }
}

function empty() {
  java.toast("别点了，用来看的")
}

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

content=java.getElement("$.content");
saybody=java.getString("$.sayBody");
say=saybody!=""?"\n作者有话要说：\n"+saybody:"";
if(baseUrl.match(/token/)){
result=String(decode(content)+say);
